description.value: Marhaba Restaurant serves 100% halal Indian and Arabic cuisine in Victoria's Saanich area, drawing on Hyderabadi culinary heritage alongside Middle Eastern flavours. The menu spans dosas, tandoor dishes, slow-cooked mandi, biryanis, and shawarma, all prepared from traditional recipes by founder Abdullah. Weekend buffets rotate daily based on seasonal ingredients and chef's specials, offering cyclists a substantial and varied meal stop.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 24m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active halal Indian and Arabic restaurant at 90 Gorge Road West, Victoria, BC, matching the OSM address and primary phone number. Takeout is confirmed by the contact page title 'Reservations, Takeout & Delivery in Victoria, BC' and the site-wide 'Order Online' feature. Vegetarian options are confirmed by dedicated 'Vegetarian Appetizers' and 'Veg-Specialities' sections in the menu; no bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (236) 470-6547 not present in OSM.
Catering page shows a different phone number (604) 722-3404, possibly for a catering coordinator or a separate location.
Website title contains typo 'Marhaba Restuarant' on several pages, versus OSM spelling 'Marhaba Restaurant'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, online ordering, and a confirmed address. A solid sit-down or takeout meal option for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Appetizers' section (samosa, veg pakora, paneer 65, chole poori, etc.) and a 'Veg-Specialities' section (dal tadka, channa masala, palak paneer, malai kofta, etc.)
